intro: Over 15 articles from April 13 to May 15, 2026, cover Rapid7’s reporting on threat actors KongTuke and Kyber. Critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-20127 and CVE-2026-20182, both with a CVSS score of 10, alongside CVE-2025-59718 and CVE-2026-41940, are highlighted. The coverage spans enterprise, enterprise IT, enterprise networking, financial services, and government sectors across Global, Europe, and North America, with a severity mix of three high, four critical, and five informational reports.
